title: 第一卷 第25章 黑麟蛇王第一卷 第26章 我大周的地盘关长生宗什么事
content_zh:
林罪站在原地没有动。
他握着砍刀，观察着四周的环境。
除了风声，几乎没有其它声音，安静得有些怪异。
他不想让自己置于危险之中。
他下意识想要离开。
但是一道想法涌上心头，春十三这种药材，既然是灵药，那用来修炼，进度是不是比吃肉快多了？
虽然危险，但是也代表着机遇，就这么走了，确实有点不甘心。
他收敛气息，放轻脚步，缓缓走向红色岩石。
距离岩石只有三四米的距离，一条黑影从岩石缝隙里探出脑袋。
随后缓缓滑到地面。
黑鳞蛇，一米多长，通体漆黑，连眼睛都是黑的，吐出的蛇芯也是黑的。
它的头顶正中央长着一株只有五厘米左右的小草，仅有一根叶片，直直地立着，边缘呈现锯齿状，通体翠绿，泛着淡淡的荧光。
叶片末端则是很多细密的根须，好像是从黑麟蛇脑袋里长出来的。
春十三。
那条黑鳞蛇察觉到了林罪。
冲着他吐了吐信子，身体缓缓从岩石缝里爬出，还剩下三分之一个身子没有爬出来。
林罪握紧紧砍刀，这条黑麟蛇，他能杀。
以他如今的力量，只要不遇到妖兽，基本没有问题。
但是下一秒，黑麟蛇突然掉了下去。
不是它自己下去的，是有什么东西从石缝底下把它硬生生往下拽。

几乎是瞬间，黑麟蛇就掉了下去。
林罪皱着眉头，整个人迅速往后退。
他所站的位置，地底下传来震动感。
轰～
一道剧烈的响声响起，红色岩石冲天而起。
一颗硕大的脑袋从地面探出头，有足球大小。
露出岩缝的半截身子就有五六米长，蛇身比成人大腿还粗，鳞片不是普通的黑色，而是一种极深极暗的纯黑。
它的嘴角挂着一截还在微弱蠕动的蛇尾，是刚才那条黑鳞蛇的尾巴。
它的头顶也长着一株春十三。
但那株春十三小得可怜，只有一条根须，像是刚从鳞片缝隙里冒出来没几天。
这是一条刚被寄生的黑麟蛇王。
且这条黑麟蛇王，还不是普通的黑麟蛇王，应该已经半步踏入妖兽的范畴了。
林罪心中只有一个念头：跑。
他转身就往怪石区外面跑。
“吼～”
content_en:
Lin Zui stood there without moving.
He held the machete and observed his surroundings.
There was almost no other sound except the wind, and it was eerily quiet.
He didn't want to put himself in danger.
He subconsciously wanted to leave.
But a thought came to mind. Since medicinal materials like Spring Thirteen are elixirs, wouldn’t the progress of cultivation be much faster than eating meat?
Although it is dangerous, it also represents an opportunity. It is indeed a bit unwilling to leave like this.
He calmed down his breath, stepped lightly, and slowly walked towards the red rock.
Only three or four meters away from the rock, a black shadow poked its head out of the crack in the rock.
Then slowly slid to the ground.
The black-scaled snake is more than one meter long, its body is pitch black, even its eyes are black, and the snake core it spits out is also black.
In the center of its head grew a small grass that was only about five centimeters long. It had only one blade, standing upright, with a jagged edge, and the whole body was emerald green and glowing with light fluorescence.
At the end of the leaves are many fine roots, which seem to grow from the head of the black snake.
Spring thirteen.
The black-scaled snake noticed Lin Sui.
She spat out the message at him and slowly crawled out of the crack in the rock, leaving a third of her body still to climb out.
Lin Zui held the machete tightly. He could kill this black snake.
With his current strength, as long as he doesn't encounter monsters, there is basically no problem.
But the next second, the Black Lin Snake suddenly fell down.
It didn't go down by itself, something pulled it down from under the cracks in the rocks.
Almost instantly, the Black Lin Snake fell down.
Lin Zui frowned and quickly stepped back.
From where he stood, there was a vibration from the ground.
Boom~
There was a violent sound, and red rocks rose into the sky.
A huge head poked out from the ground, the size of a football.
The half of its body exposed in the rock crevice is five or six meters long. The snake's body is thicker than an adult's thigh. Its scales are not ordinary black, but a very deep and dark pure black.
Hanging from the corner of its mouth was a snake tail that was still squirming weakly. It was the tail of the black-scaled snake just now.
There is also a spring thirteen plant growing on its head.
But the Spring Thirteen plant was pitifully small, with only one root, as if it had just emerged from the gap between the scales a few days ago.
This is a newly parasitized black snake king.
And this Black Lin Snake King is not an ordinary Black Lin Snake King, it should have already half-stepped into the category of a monster.
Lin Zui had only one thought in his mind: run.
He turned around and ran outside the strange rock area.
"Roar~"
